title: Name the Mid-360 and GPS as the way the robot finds its position
summary: The mission sentence on the site and in the README said the robot finds its way with GPS alone. The stage 2 walking requirements name the pose source since 7 November: Livox Mid-360 lidar-inertial odometry for local position and heading, and GPS without RTK for the global frame. The mission sentence and the Track position part of the system diagram now say a Livox Mid-360 laser scanner and GPS. The page had grown to 662 words after the Movement test term changed on this branch, over the 650-word limit of site/test_render.mjs; the term is shorter and the page shows 650 words, so the render test passes again. The limit is unchanged.
next: Add the owner-file existence check to the site checker; then the ARCHITECTURE rewrite and the navigation guide.
reason: The published mission sentence changes to match the pose source that the requirements file decides. No result, roadmap state or gate changes.
